title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to set the minimum and maximum numeric values ​​for a field
summary: Business Central offers two simple ways to limit numeric field values: the MinValue and MaxValue properties on table or page fields, or custom range checks in OnValidate triggers. The properties are only checked when values change through the UI, not when application code sets the field, and they cannot exclude the boundary values.
key_points: MinValue and MaxValue on a table or page field enforce an inclusive range and show a standard error when a value falls outside it.
The property check runs for UI updates on pages or direct table edits, but not when application code assigns the value.
Properties cannot express strict bounds such as only values above zero.
An OnValidate trigger on the table field can hold custom range logic and raise an error; it runs before the page field OnValidate trigger.
